purpose: Realizable torsional sensitivity and periodic restricted-energy topology, descriptive only

cohort.selection: all completed isomers, first archived conformer
cohort.parent_aggregation: equal parent weights where summarizing paired isomers

torsions.eligibility: single bridge bond with each endpoint heavy degree at least two
torsions.ordering: root depth then parent atom index then child atom index
torsions.chemical_scope: kinematic bridge rotations; includes restricted single bonds, no claim of freely rotating chemistry

constraints: squared distances for heavy graph distance one or two; singular nullspaces are only infinitesimal diagnostics

response.local_normalization: fixed baseline norm separately per representation, floor 1e-12

case.selection: previously frozen highest target coverage then hash; first two eligible ordered axes
case.energy: MMFF94s with hydrogens optimized once while every heavy atom is fixed; subsequent exact two-axis rotations; all other internal coordinates fixed; baseline E(0,0) subtraction shared across grid sizes
case.hydrogen_seed: RDKit AddHs(addCoords=True) on archived heavy coordinates, deterministic
case.model_scope: explicit reduced kinetic model on fixed two-dimensional family, not full molecular canonical ensemble or binding free energy
case.descriptor_scale: one shared uniform fine-grid RMS for two isomers, fixed before comparing weight rules
case.persistence: GUDHI PeriodicCubicalComplex(vertices=energy, periodic_dimensions=[true,true]); coefficient field F2, retain essential H0,H1,H2; no continuum convergence certification
case.mirror_control: reflection of the same labelled all-atom geometry and negation of angles; energy and quotient metric even, response odd

fixed_math_checks: bridge chart bond/angle preservation and mixed derivatives
mass quotient metric analytic gradient and Christoffel symmetry
fixed-filtration response Hessian includes chart acceleration
constant periodic grid terminal Betti numbers (1,2,1)
reflection covariance on same labelled molecule
inference: No new bioactivity prediction test; existing 103-parent association remains unchanged; energy-surface case is a mechanistic illustration of representation and measure limits
